description: Mode I hexatonic scale (root, b3, 4, 5, 6, b7 above the drone note), fingered by opening holes sequentially starting from the one nearest the foot end - the most commonly published tuning for a 6-hole Native American flute. Other traditions/makers use different modes and cross-fingerings; this chart covers only the primary scale tones, so the leading tone and all-holes-open fingering are left undefined rather than guessed at.
